same_sample_price_robustness.method: Identical transaction hashes at all three lagged completed-minute close benchmarks; no stale-price fallback. Holdings and gas treatment fixed. Price mapping follows original evidence. Not confidence intervals or a causal MEV estimate.

local_effect_decomposition.method: Exact telescoping local benchmark in raw output units: input at pre-front spot -> same spot with 0.3% fee -> finite-size no-front AMM output (integer rounded) -> actual target output. Components depend on this order, are not additive with CEX shortfall or beneficiary profits. Inputs fixed; not full route/slippage/behavioral replay.
